## Meeting prep — Ashford Household
**Tax planning review** · in 9 days · HNW · $4,300,000 AUM

### What prompted this meeting
Asked whether harvesting in the account can offset the gain on a rental property sold this year.

### Portfolio snapshot
- YTD return: 7.9%
- Unrealized gain/loss: $335,000
- Harvestable losses: $193,000 (~$45,934 illustrative tax alpha)

### Concentration & risk
No policy breaches flagged this cycle.

### CIO alignment
Low drift. "On model" In line with model.

### Suggested talking points
1. Asked whether harvesting in the account can offset the gain on a rental property sold this year.
2. Flag $193,000 of harvestable losses (~$45,934 illustrative tax alpha) ahead of year-end.

### Eligible next steps
- Tax Efficient Rebalancing (TER)
- Quarterly Loss Harvesting (QLH)
- Securities-Based Lending
- Trust & Estate
- Insurance / Annuity

ashford.headline: 33% of the account ($1,400,000) is covered by at least one overlay; $1,800,000 is in a TEM Style Manager Strategy whose manager handles tax management. QLH would harvest 2 lots at a 5%+ loss ($77,500 of losses).

gates.label: Taxable account

coverage.label: Tax Efficient Rebalancing
coverage.approach: Best tax lot selection, account-level wash sale protection, short-term gain deferral, tax-prioritized withdrawals
coverage.eligible_investments: Style Manager Strategies in individual equities or certain preferreds; ETFs; mutual funds. Never fixed income securities.

coverage.label: Quarterly Loss Harvesting
coverage.approach: Harvests tax lots at a loss of 5% or more, subject to a portfolio turnover limit; proceeds go to a replacement ETF for the wash sale period
coverage.eligible_investments: Style Manager Strategies in individual equities or certain preferreds; ETFs; mutual funds. Never fixed income securities.

coverage.label: Dynamic Tax Loss Harvesting
coverage.frequency: Ongoing; market-derived thresholds that account for volatility
coverage.approach: Opportunistically harvests losses in eligible CIO ETF strategies; replacement ETFs keep the allocation and risk profile
coverage.eligible_investments: Only eligible CIO strategies that consist solely of ETFs.

qlh.replacement_note: Harvest proceeds go into a replacement ETF chosen to keep market exposure; after the 30-day wash sale period it is sold and the original securities are bought back if the strategy still holds them.

ter.deferral_note: The TEM Guide restricts sales of short-term lots with sizable gains that go long-term within 31 days or less; the TER Term Sheet says sales may be deferred by as many as 30 days. The term sheets do not define "sizable", so Atlas lists every gain lot in the window.
ter.withdrawal_note: Tax-prioritized withdrawals sell overweight positions first, then the largest percentage losses, using best tax lots. Atlas has no security-level targets, so this shows the loss-first order.

dtlh.note: DTLH thresholds are market-derived and not published, so Atlas shows the positions DTLH watches rather than predicting trades.

source_doc.section: An example of Dynamic Tax Loss Harvesting

example.note: Stated values only: ETF AB worth $1,000 in January falls to $940 in February, meets the threshold and is swapped into CD; CD falls to $900 in April and is swapped back into AB.

dtlh.removal_note: If DTLH is removed, replacement ETFs are sold and reinvested in the strategy, which may realize gains.

considerations.message: VWO is also held in Daniel's rollover IRA at another firm. The overlays only see this account, so a purchase there within 30 days of a harvest here can disallow the loss. Monitoring across accounts is the client’s responsibility.
Selecting TER replaces any tax relief (lot selection) method previously given to the advisor for this account.
QLH harvests subject to a portfolio turnover limit set by the firm; not every eligible loss is harvested (wash sale, restrictions, turnover, size).

paths.label: Overlays on the current strategy
paths.what: Elect TER, plus QLH or DTLH, on a Managed Strategy. The strategy decides which services are available.

paths.label: Custom Managed: overlays sleeve by sleeve
paths.what: TER and QLH apply to eligible mutual fund, ETF and Style Manager sleeves; DTLH to CIO ETF sleeves. TEM Style Manager Strategies cannot be sleeves.
paths.why: Would let different sleeves carry different overlays. TEM Style Manager Strategies still could not be sleeves.

paths.label: A TEM Style Manager Strategy
paths.what: A stand-alone managed strategy whose manager does the tax management (direct indexing and tax-managed SMAs). Overlays are not applied to it.
paths.why: Held inside the Natixis Moderate SMA/ETF Tax Aware model.

paths.label: An Investment Manager Model that can hold TEM Style Manager Strategies
paths.what: A tax-aware multi-manager model that may hold TEM Style Manager Strategies. Overlays can be elected for its other eligible holdings, never for the TEM Style Manager Strategies inside it.
